facets.label: Access model
facets.description: What it takes to get a response from the source's preferred access method. Orthogonal to authority: a keyed or subscription source is not more authoritative for being gated.

values.label: Open
values.description: No key or login; anyone can call it (possibly with a shared rate limit).

values.label: Keyed
values.description: A free or self-service key, token or contact identifier is required or strongly expected (credential_ref).

values.label: Subscription
values.description: Content is licensed; the key or session must carry a subscription entitlement for full text.

values.label: Institutional
values.description: Entitlement comes from Ellie's institution (UC Davis) via campus IP, library VPN, SSO session, or an institutional token.

facets.label: Content depth
facets.description: How far toward quotable text the source's responses go.

values.label: Metadata
values.description: Bibliographic records only (titles, authors, DOIs, venues, citation links).

values.label: Abstract
values.description: Abstracts (or reconstructed abstracts) as well as metadata.

values.label: OA location
values.description: Pointers to legal free-to-read copies (URL, version, licence).

values.label: Full text
values.description: The article bytes themselves (PDF, XML, HTML).

notes: Two axes chosen so the deep-research skill can ask, e.g., --facet access_model=open --facet content_depth=full_text. Licence/OA status of an individual work is a per-record fact, not a source facet (see report).
